title: Find a transaction in a member's history by its reference
description: Opens a member's transaction history, pages through it to the transaction with the given reference, and returns its date and amount.
goal: Sign on, look up member {{inputs.memberId}}, open their transaction history, find the transaction with reference {{inputs.reference}} (it may be on a later page), and read its date and amount.

probes.why: a member number that doesn't exist
